[[File:E11BlasterRifle-NEGWT.png|thumb|right|200px|The [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]]: the most famous weapon of the E-series.]]
The '''E-series''' was a series of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster weapons]] produced by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] over a long period of time spanning at least from the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="FF104">{{FactFile|104|BAT 1-2|Battle Droid Blaster}}</ref>

One of the most successful design of the series was the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]]. A more ancient BlasTech E-series blaster was illegally reverse-engineered by [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]] prior to the Invasion of Naboo to develop the [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]]: the weapon that equipped the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="FF104" />
